chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, cursed al-wāṣilah and al-muttaṣilah.

key_terms.الْمُوتَصِلَةَ: al-muttaṣilah; the woman for whom this joining is done
key_terms.الْوَاصِلَةَ: al-wāṣilah; the woman who joins or attaches hair
key_terms.لَعَنَ: pronounced a curse upon; declared condemned

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about al-wāṣilah and al-muttaṣilah?
ai.summary: This report states that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله cursed al-wāṣilah and al-muttaṣilah. It conveys a prohibition concerning the practice indicated by these terms and presents it as blameworthy in the Prophetic sunnah.
